sections.title: Open gaps
sections.content: The brief does not state the deliverables, deadline, budget, target audience or constraints; the client should confirm each of them.

sections.title: Open issues and questions
sections.content:
- [high] missing_information: The brief names no deliverables and no audience, so the work cannot be sized.
- [medium] ambiguity: "Make it nice" gives no usable design direction.
- [high] timeline_risk: No deadline or timeline is given.
- [high] budget_risk: No budget is given.
- Ask: What should the website do, and which pages or features do you need?
- Ask: When do you need the website to be ready?
- Ask: What budget do you have in mind for this project?
- Ask: What does "nice" mean to you -- can you share an example of a website you like?

response_json.summary: No acceptance criteria could be drafted because the brief states only a goal, and Brief Decoder flagged four open issues. Ask the client the listed questions first.
